_readme: Focus topics: time-boxed showcase sections that appear right under the lead story. A focus is live when enabled is true and today (India time) falls within start + days. While any focus is live, the regular sections shrink to regularQuotasWhenFocused. keywords only decide which older items (up to lookbackHours) are kept as focus candidates; Claude still judges relevance from the brief. sources are extra feeds fetched only while that focus is live, same format as config/sources.json. Pin a link to a focus section from the Sheet: set section to the focus key and status to pin.
